files.README.md:
# Tunnel latency report

python3 -m latency.cli reads data/probes.csv and prints an export. Row encoding uses an in-memory CSV writer.
files.latency/export.py:
from .projection import project_readings
def iter_export_rows(records):
    yield 'tunnel,latency_ms\n'
    yield from project_readings(records)
